seo.title: Cycle Easy — Private Period Tracker for iOS
seo.description: Cycle Easy is a private period tracker for iPhone. See your cycle day and when your next period is likely, log how you feel, and keep everything on your device. Works with Apple Health.

hero.label: PERIOD TRACKER
hero.title: Your cycle, on your iPhone.
text: See your cycle day, when your next period is likely and how you feel. No account, no servers, no iCloud: your cycle stays on your device, where it belongs.

sections.label: FEATURES
sections.title: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.

items.title: Today
items.text: Your cycle day leads the screen, with a ring that closes as your next period gets close. Start or end a period in one tap.

items.title: Predictions
items.text: Your next period, estimated from your own last six cycles. Until you've logged two, it uses the usual length you set.

items.title: Calendar
items.text: Logged periods, the days your next one is likely and, if you turn it on, the estimated fertile window. Tap any day to log it.

items.title: Symptoms and mood
items.text: Cramps, headaches, bloating, cravings, mood and more in a few taps. Insights shows which cycle days they usually come on.

items.title: Insights
items.text: Average cycle and period length, your shortest and longest cycles, a chart of the last six, and the next three periods.

items.title: Private widgets
items.text: Your cycle day on the Home Screen and Lock Screen. Widgets never show anything about your period.

sections.label: APPLE HEALTH
sections.title: Optional. Off until you connect it.
text: Connect Apple Health and Cycle Easy reads menstrual flow, so periods you saved there show up in your calendar, and writes menstrual flow for each day of the periods you log. It reads and writes nothing else, and Health data stays in Apple Health on your iPhone.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your cycle stays yours.
text: No account, no servers, no analytics and no iCloud. Cycle Easy keeps your data out of backups too, so there's nothing to hand over. Lock the app with Face ID, export your data to a file, or delete it all in one step.
Predictions are estimates from your own history. They aren't medical advice or birth control.
